class.name: FmodAudioEffectRecord
class.brief_description: Captures audio passing through a bus and exposes it as a WAV resource.
class.description: FmodAudioEffectRecord captures audio data passing through an audio bus and records it to an internal buffer. When recording is complete, the captured audio can be saved as an [AudioStreamWAV] resource. This effect is useful for recording gameplay audio, capturing microphone input (when applied to a microphone bus), or creating audio samples from synthesized sounds. To start recording, apply the effect to an audio bus and set [member recording_active] to [code]true[/code]. To stop, set [member recording_active] to [code]false[/code] and call [method get_recording] to retrieve the recorded audio as an [AudioStreamWAV].

method.name: set_recording_active
method.description: Starts or stops recording. Changing from inactive to active clears the previous recording and allocates a new capture buffer. Setting the current state again does nothing. Stopping preserves captured samples for [method get_recording].

method.name: get_recording
method.description: Returns a new [AudioStreamWAV] containing a copy of the captured samples, or [code]null[/code] if no audio has been recorded. It does not consume or clear the recording. Stop recording first when a completed recording is required.

method.name: get_waveform_snapshot
method.description: Returns a waveform envelope for the latest [param seconds] of recorded audio. A nonpositive duration uses the entire recording. For each of [param width] horizontal buckets, two [Vector2] elements contain the normalized x position and the minimum or maximum sample value, in that order. Channels are averaged and amplitudes are clamped to -1.0 through 1.0. Returns an empty array for a nonpositive width or no recorded audio; otherwise the array has [code]width * 2[/code] elements.

members.member: The sample format used when [method get_recording] exports the captured floating-point samples. Changing it does not change the capture buffer. [constant FORMAT_IMA_ADPCM] currently exports 16-bit PCM, like [constant FORMAT_16_BITS].

If [code]true[/code], the effect is currently recording audio from the bus. Set to [code]true[/code] to start recording and [code]false[/code] to stop. After stopping, call [method get_recording] to retrieve the captured audio.

constants.constant: 8-bit PCM audio format. Smaller file size but lower audio quality with audible quantization noise. Suitable for low-quality recordings or when memory is constrained.
16-bit PCM audio format (default). Good balance between audio quality and file size. Recommended for most recording applications.
IMA ADPCM request value. The current implementation exports 16-bit PCM WAV data for this setting; it does not encode IMA ADPCM.
